mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: European Road Trip Planner is dedicated to helping travelers discover the beauty of Europe through the freedom of a road trip. We believe that exploring by car offers unique experiences that can't be had through other means of transportation.

story.title: Our Story
story.content: Our journey began in 2020 when a group of passionate European travelers decided to share their experience and knowledge to help others plan the perfect car journey through Europe.

team.title: Our Team
team.content: Our team is made up of experienced travelers, writers, and developers who are passionate about exploration and discovery. We come from various European countries, bringing a local perspective to our guides and advice.
